recommended_approach: Rigid Body — Combined Hero Destruction: pre-fracture the window into impact-centered irregular shards (Voronoi/Cell Fracture style), assign each shard an ACTIVE rigid body, glue adjacent shards with FIXED rigid body constraints using use_breaking=True and distance-based breaking_threshold values, drive the brick with a kinematic-to-active handoff at impact, and optionally add a short particle-chip burst for fine secondary debris.

key_parameters.RigidBodyConstraint.breaking_threshold: 8.0 + dist * 35.0 (weaker near impact, stronger toward frame edges)
key_parameters.RigidBodyObject.collision_shape: CONVEX_HULL for glass shards; BOX for brick
key_parameters.RigidBodyObject.kinematic: Brick True on approach, then False at impact frame

warnings: Basic pre-fracture without breakable FIXED constraints tends to make all shards fall at once instead of producing impact-led fracture propagation.
For a fast brick impact, raise scene.rigidbody_world.substeps_per_frame and solver_iterations; the Blender 5.0 pattern explicitly notes to use substeps_per_frame, not steps_per_second.
Use a very small RigidBodyObject.collision_margin (~0.001) for thin glass shards to avoid unstable contacts and inflated spacing.
A projectile driven only by physics from frame 1 can miss or hit inconsistently; the proven pattern is kinematic on approach, then active at impact.
The Cell Fracture workflow requires enabling the object_cell_fracture add-on before calling bpy.ops.object.add_fracture_cell_objects().
Rigid-body hero shards alone can look too clean; add secondary particle chips if the break lacks fine debris.
alternative_approaches: Cell Fracture add-on workflow: enable object_cell_fracture, run bpy.ops.object.add_fracture_cell_objects(), then assign ACTIVE rigid bodies to the resulting pieces; simpler setup but less progressive than a breakable-constraint network.
Constraint-Based Glass Shattering only: keep the pre-fractured shards and FIXED breakable constraints, but skip particle-chip augmentation if performance or setup time is tighter.
Hybrid backup: large visible shards as rigid bodies plus a ParticleSettings-driven chip burst for micro-fragments that would be too expensive to simulate as full rigid bodies.
